This PR replaces managed Linux code-server installer scripts with checksum-verified archives, changes default Tailscale package bootstrap to a signed APT repository with a pinned keyring, keeps pinned static mode, and updates docs/tests across the Go CLI and Worker generators.

Reproducibility: yes. for the source-level issue: current main still emits root Code and default Tailscale curl-to-shell installer paths in both bootstrap generators. I did not run a live installer compromise or the after-fix exact-head Tailscale lease canary.

target.title: fix: harden managed Linux bootstrap
target.body:
Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/715.
Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/816.

Supersedes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/742 because GitHub rejected maintainer pushes to the contributor fork despite maintainer edits being enabled. This replacement preserves Andy Ye as co-author and keeps @TurboTheTurtle's changelog credit.

## Summary

- Replace managed Linux Code Server root installer scripts with pinned, checksum-verified archives in both CLI and coordinator bootstrap generators.
- Preserve Tailscale's default package contract through its signed APT repository with a checksum-pinned keyring; keep checksum-verified static archives as the explicit pinned mode.
- Keep Go and Worker mode parsing aligned, including case-insensitive pinned selection.
- Remove downloaded archives before copying install roots and disarm temporary-directory traps after successful cleanup.
- Update operator documentation and regression coverage.

## Verification

Exact candidate: `ed63b03aa628f8c51aaea33cd7522514cbc20e1b`, rebased onto current `main`.

- `go test -race ./...` — pass.
- `go vet ./...` — pass.
- `npm run format:check --prefix worker` — pass.
- `npm run lint --prefix worker` — pass.
- `npm run check --prefix worker` — pass.
- `npm test --prefix worker` — 789 tests passed.
- `npm run build --prefix worker` — pass.
- `node scripts/build-docs-site.mjs` and `git diff --check` — pass.
- Exact-branch autoreview — clean, no accepted/actionable findings (0.83).
- Upstream v4.126.0 release metadata reports the same amd64 and arm64 SHA-256 digests pinned in both generators.
- Implementation-equivalent pre-rebase Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 container canary downloaded the pinned 171 MiB Code Server artifact, verified its digest, installed the generated layout, ran `code-server --version` (`4.126.0`), and proved temporary-directory cleanup.
- Implementation-equivalent pre-rebase Ubuntu 24.04 Tailscale package canary verified the pinned keyring, installed Tailscale 1.98.8 from the signed stable repository, and resolved package provenance to `pkgs.tailscale.com`.

## Exact live gate

An exact-candidate brokered AWS `standard` lease request with `--tailscale` reached the production coordinator but failed before VM creation: the coordinator's Tailscale OAuth exchange returned HTTP 401 `API token invalid`. No AWS VM, provider SSH key, or tailnet node was created, so the failed attempt left zero residue.

The direct-provider fallback is also unavailable from this host: the local AWS identity currently returns `InvalidClientTokenId`. The targeted personal Tailscale credential lookup is paused at the existing 1Password desktop unlock boundary; no key was printed, copied, created, or rotated.

The remaining merge gate is one disposable managed Linux lease with Tailscale enabled on this exact head: verify the installed client version and a `100.x` tailnet address, then prove provider key, VM, and tailnet-node cleanup. Fixing or replacing production coordinator credentials is deliberately not part of this code PR.
